text: Transwestern has spent $60,962.54 to date on the work from Penn State. I will code this and have a check issued; however, I am concerned that the direction Transwestern should take is not clear to all parties involved. I would like to discuss this and am considering a conference call with the people on the distribution list above, as well as any other interested Enron personnel, to outline the PCB plans and Penn State modeling efforts for 2001.
